podcast.title: Suicide and Legacy
podcast.body: Jim Ellison, the singer for Material Issue, tragically committed suicide, which derailed the band's career. His life and music left a lasting impact, inspiring The Tragically Hip's song "Escape is at Hand for the Traveling Man" and being honored by the annual "International Pop Over Throw" festival in Chicago. "However, their spirit lives on. Chicago, host an annual festival called International Pop Over Throw that's been going on since 1997, and it features bands in the whole PowerPop vein."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Tragic End of Singer
xref.body: Material Issue's career was "derailed by the sudden suicide of singer Jim Ellison." Despite this tragedy, their spirit continues, notably through an annual Powerpop festival in Chicago named "International Pop Over Throw," inspired by their album title. "I love these guys, but they were derailed by the sudden suicide of singer Jim Ellison."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
